stories.title: Tornado Causes Injuries and Damage in Southwestern France
stories.summary: A tornado struck the village of Pomas in southwestern France, injuring at least 39 people and damaging over 300 homes. The event has been described as rare and traumatic, with reports of significant destruction and ongoing rescue efforts in the affected areas.

stories.title: Trial for Lockerbie Bombing Suspect Delayed Due to New Evidence
stories.summary: The trial of a Libyan man accused of involvement in the 1988 Lockerbie bombing has been postponed for a third time. A U.S. federal judge made the decision after new evidence emerged just three days prior to the scheduled start of the trial. The bombing resulted in the deaths of 270 people, including 259 on board Pan Am Flight 103 and 11 on the ground in Lockerbie, Scotland.

stories.title: Supreme Court Allows Trump to Move Forward with Mail Voting Restrictions
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has granted a 6-3 decision allowing the Trump administration to proceed with parts of an executive order aimed at restricting mail voting. This order includes the creation of 'state citizenship lists' and gives the Postal Service authority over mail-in ballot distribution. The ruling does not represent a final decision on the legality of the order, as the administration seeks to implement these changes ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.

stories.title: Trump Administration Plans to Revoke Visas of Up to 200,000 Asylum Seekers
stories.summary: The Trump administration is reportedly preparing to revoke the visas of up to 200,000 foreigners who have applied for or are currently seeking asylum in the United States. This action could represent the largest mass visa revocation in U.S. history, targeting individuals who entered the country on tourist or business visas.

stories.title: Study Reveals High CTE Rates Among Deceased Former NFL Players
stories.summary: A recent study found that at least 25% of former NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 had chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), a brain disease associated with repeated head injuries. This rate is significantly higher than that observed in the general population, highlighting ongoing concerns about the long-term effects of playing football.

A handgun was found nearby. This discovery concludes a multi-day search for Solomon, who was a mental health advocate for law enforcement.

stories.title: US Treasury Secretary Initiates 'Operation Economic Outcast' to Target Iran
stories.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced 'Operation Economic Outcast' aimed at isolating Iran economically. He stated that any entity facilitating money laundering for Iran would be excluded from the US dollar system. Concurrently, the Iranian rial fell to a record low of approximately 2.02 million to the dollar, as Bessent warned of an impending 'economic D-Day' for Iran.

stories.title: Trump's PAC Invests in Darline Graham Ahead of South Carolina Runoff
stories.summary: MAGA Inc., a super PAC associated with Donald Trump, has made a significant investment of over $827,000 in voter outreach for Darline Graham in her South Carolina runoff election. This comes as Graham seeks to retain her brother's Senate seat amidst a challenging political landscape, where Trump's endorsement record is under scrutiny following several gubernatorial losses this cycle. Some Trump supporters remain skeptical about Graham's candidacy as the runoff approaches.
